title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering -> regional failover stability
author: Maya Patel
description: Summary: urgent stabilization and ordering fix for the SLO enforcer backoff logic that caused regional failover thrashing under partial network partitions. Motivation: customers observed repeated regional failovers in production when a subset of routers experienced intermittent latency spikes; investigation traced the issue to non-deterministic ordering of backoff/unblock updates in the enforcer which allowed multiple regions to mark themselves unhealthy concurrently and trigger failovers. This PR fixes ordering, adds stronger hysteresis, and adds a small quorum check to avoid simultaneous regional demotions. Includes smoke tests, integration test adjustments, observability updates, and a rollback plan. Checklist: - [x] Reproduce locally with partition simulator - [x] Unit tests for ordering semantics - [x] Integration test for regional failover hysteresis - [x] Metrics emitted for backoff state transitions - [x] Runload in perf-canary (10k requests/min) - [x] Documentation + release notes - [x] Oncall runbook updated Changeset overview: - Ensure single-writer update path for region backoff state (serialize updates through enforcer apply loop) - Introduce per-region backoff epoch counters to enforce monotonic updates - Add 30s hysteresis window when flipping region healthy->unhealthy and 45s for unhealthy->healthy - Add quorum check (majority of enforcers) before triggering cross-region failover - Add metrics: slo_enforcer.backoff_epoch, slo_enforcer.hysteresis_state, slo_enforcer.quorum_votes - Tighten logging for state transitions and add a sampling policy to avoid log storm under thrashing Backwards compatibility: config defaults preserve previous behavior except for the additional hysteresis timing which is conservative and controlled by feature flag env SLO_ENFORCER_HYSTERESIS_MS. Rollback: revert head branch; feature flag gate allows disabling hysteresis for quick rollback in emergency; follow rollback runbook. Notes: this is an urgent hotfix tied to an incident (SUP-1284); applied to main with squash merge.
